```{=html}
<div class="pub-filter" role="toolbar" aria-label="Filter publications by topic">
<button class="pf active" data-topic="all">All</button>
<button class="pf" data-topic="pa">Protected areas</button>
<button class="pf" data-topic="lu">Landscape ecology</button>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
  var pubs=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.pub'));
  var btns=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.pf'));
  function has(p,t){return (' '+p.dataset.topics+' ').indexOf(' '+t+' ')>-1;}
  btns.forEach(function(b){
    var t=b.dataset.topic;
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      btns.forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('active');});b.classList.add('active');
      document.body.classList.toggle('pub-filtered',t!=='all');
      pubs.forEach(function(p){p.style.display=(t==='all'||has(p,t))?'':'none';});
      document.querySelectorAll('section.level2').forEach(function(sec){
        var ps=[].slice.call(sec.querySelectorAll('.pub'));
        if(!ps.length) return;
        sec.style.display=ps.some(function(p){return p.style.display!=='none';})?'':'none';
        var h=sec.querySelector('h2'); if(h) h.style.display=(t==='all')?'':'none';
      });
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
